quarterly_data.quarter: ChipMOS press release: ChipMOS REPORTS 33.3% YoY INCREASE IN AUGUST 2026 REVENUE (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ChipMOS August 2026 unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$2,785.7 million (US$88.0 million), down 1.3% from July 2026 (NT$2,823.0 million) and up 33.3% from August 2025 (NT$2,090.3 million). The company said it continues to benefit from strong memory demand led by a persistent AI-related demand/supply imbalance, is working closely with customers on their near- and long-term requirements, and remains disciplined in footprint expansion, with new capacity aligned to committed customer demand.
